select fish_date_season as season, cls, fish_date_doy as doy, sum(yt) as yt, sum(anglers) as anglers, count(*) as n_boats,
  round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),3) as yt_per_angler
from trips
where fish_date_season=1 and fish_date_doy between 280 and 305 and cls in ('full_day','three_quarter')
group by season, cls, doy
order by cls, doy

select cls, count(*) n, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang, round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),3) ypa
from trips
where fish_date_season=1 and fish_date_doy between 270 and 310
group by cls order by ypa desc

select cls, count(*) n, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) ypa
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy between 91 and 121
group by cls order by ypa desc
select index_id, avail_season, avail_doy, value from climate where avail_season=2 order by avail_doy desc limit 8

SELECT (fish_date_doy/10)::int*10 AS decade, cls,
       SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS yt_per_angler,
       COUNT(*) AS n_trips
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 60 AND 121
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT cls, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) yt_per_angler, COUNT(*) n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=1 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 280 AND 305
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC
